resources.string: Stories, poems, scripture, news and textbooks each get their own pace. A story\'s lines are read the way their words say: whispered softer, shouted louder, sad lines slower.
Reading the first pages to tell what kind of book this is.
a story: lines with feeling, dialogue a touch quicker
a storybook: slower and warmer, with feeling
an official text: even and clear
study material: clear, with room after headings
Pauses at punctuation, sound, a voice for dialogue and characters, study and focus sounds
